id.description: Canonical C3 Identifier for this Cloud Resource in the format of <cluster>-<env>-<app>-<func>[-<role>]-<seq>[-<subseq>].

env.description:
C3 Environment name (second) component in {@link #id}; e.g. srv,ui,c3.
E.g. prod-c3-crm-app-l-0001
=> c3
An Environment name must be unique within a Cluster.

app.description:
C3 Application name (third) component in {@link #id}; e.g. c3,crm,lightbulb
E.g. prod-c3-crm-app-l-0001
=> crm
An Application name must be unique within an Environment.

role.description:
C3 role; e.g. m, w; cannot be number only.
E.g. prod-c3-crm-app-l-0001
=> l

@see CloudResource#cloudRoles

seq.description:
Sequence number - should only contain numbers - it is recommended to have fixed number of digits for a
`<func>-<role>` with 0 left padding so that list of resources are naturally ordered; can be 2, 3, 4 or 5 digits.
E.g. prod-c3-crm-app-l-0001
=> 0001

@see CloudResource#cloudSeqLength

subseq.description:
Sub-sequence alphanumeric string (dot allowed)
E.g. prod-c3-crm-app-t-0001-kk03
=> 001

resourceId.description: Cloud service provider generated native ID, such as vpcId and securityGroupId.

resourceSecondaryId.description: Cloud service provider generated native secondary ID, such as Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

resourceName.description: User defined name attribute managed by cloud service provider.

resourceGroupName.description: ResourceGroup for Azure resources and K8s namespaces

fullyConfigured.description:
When true, CloudResource will GET from locally persisted Config framework
When false, CloudResource will GET from remote Cloud APIs

resourceNamespace.description: resourceNamespace for K8s Resources (only those which are associated with a namespace)

external.description:
This flag indicates that this cloud resource managed by third party, C3 will not create or destroy this resource
implicitly.

issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

nativeMetricByName.description:
This table has logical metrics as keys and native metrics as values.
For example, 'cpu' could map to native metric 'CPUUTILIZATION' for {@link AwsEc2Instance}

tags.description: Cloud tags assigned to this resource.

description.description: Customized description for the cloud resource.

parentResource.description: Parent Cloud Resource that this children cloud resource belongs to

securityGroups.description: The id of the child security groups of the resource.

status.description: Specifies the current state of this cluster

dbName.description:
By specifying a dbName here, we create another database in addition to the default database named "dev". This name
cannot be modified. Not Modifiable for a existing cluster.

dbPort.description: The port number on which the database accepts connections. Default value is 5439. Not Modifiable for a existing cluster.

masterUserName.description: Name of master user for your cluster. (e.g. awsuser). Not modifiable for a existing cluster.

masterUserPassword.description:
If no set here, a random password will be auto-generated and used. Password must contain 8 to 64 printable ASCII characters excluding: /, ", ', \, and @.
It must contain 1 uppercase letter, 1 lowercase letter, and 1 number. Modifiable for a existing cluster.

updatingMasterUserPassword.description: Indicate whether the masterUserPassword is being modified.

instanceType.description: The node type to be provisioned for the cluster. Modifiable for a existing cluster.

instanceCount.description:
The number of nodes in the cluster. Default value is 1 if not set here. For nodeType "DC1_LARGE" or "DS2_XLARGE", 1 <= nodeNumber <= 32.
For nodeType "DC1_8XLARGE" or "DS2_8XLARGE", 1 <= nodeNumber <= 100. Modifiable for a existing cluster.

instances.description: Information of nodes in the cluster.

subnetGroupName.description:
The name of the subnet group that is associated with the cluster. This parameter is valid only when the cluster is
in a VPC.

isPubliclyAccessible.description:
Specifies the accessibility options for the cluster. The default is False.
True specifies an Internet-facing instance with a publicly resolvable DNS name, which resolves to a public IP address.
False specifies an internal instance with a DNS name that resolves to a private IP address.

isEnhancedVpcRouting.description:
An option that specifies whether to create the cluster with enhanced VPC routing enabled. To create a cluster that
uses enhanced VPC routing, the cluster must be in a VPC.

isDbDataEncrypted.description: A Boolean value that, if true , indicates that data in the database is encrypted at rest.

availabilityZone.description:
The EC2 Availability Zone (AZ) in which you want Amazon Redshift to provision the cluster. For example, if you have
several EC2 instances running in a specific Availability Zone, then you might want the cluster to be provisioned
in the same zone in order to decrease network latency.

iamRoles.description: A list of AWS IAM roles that can be used by the cluster to access other AWS services.

title: AwsRedshift is a fast, fully managed, petabyte-scale data warehouse.
name: AwsRedShift
